name: microsoft_marketplace-mcp
description: Microsoft Marketplace / AppSource (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_microsoft_marketplace_clien.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_microsoft_marketplace_clien.description: Microsoft Entra application (client) ID added to the Partner Center account.

platform_mcp_microsoft_marketplace_clien.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_microsoft_marketplace_clien.description: Client secret of that Entra application.

platform_mcp_microsoft_marketplace_tenan.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_MARKETPLACE_TENANT_ID
platform_mcp_microsoft_marketplace_tenan.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID of the publisher (Partner Center > Account settings).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one product (GET product?$maxpagesize=1&$version=...) to confirm the Entra app is authorised on the Partner Center account.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET product?$maxpagesize=&$version= ('Query string parameters are used to query details pertaining to your products'). name is the product alias; type (softwareAsAService, azureContainer, ...) and identity.externalID is in raw; id is the durable id 'product/<guid>'. A continuationToken from a previous response may be passed as cursor; the response field that carries it is not named in the docs, so next_cursor is not set - read raw if a further page exists.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET <resource-durableID>?$version= returns the draft configuration of the product; pass the id returned by list_products ('product/<guid>'). Plans, listings and price-and-availability live in GET resource-tree/<product-durableID>.
